sourcePolicy: Derived only from user-supplied authorized Grok turnaround files; originals remain read-only.
generationMethod: Deterministic transforms of the cleaned Grok five-direction turnaround: shared-pivot breathing, four-zone alternating limb phase, run lean and stride, pant squash, sleep flattening plus eyelid correction, happy jump, and safe mirrored right directions.
preprocessing: edge-connected neutral-background flood removal from the selected JPEG
content-connected-component detection for five authored directions
remove the source ground shadow with the connected background mask
quantize directly to the shared 32-color character palette
extract five authored direction bases and mirror three safe right directions at 96x96
preserve indexed low-color source pixels and binary alpha
apply deterministic per-animation deformation around pivot x=48 y=78
normalize grounded frames to feet y=78
keep authored left directions and previously audited safe right mirrors
encode 768x768 lossless WebP with no baked shadow
knownIssues: Source turnaround contains one static authored frame per direction; motion is deterministic local deformation rather than independently authored Grok animation drawings.
Sleep eyelids are local pixel corrections over the source eyes.
Human visual approval is still required before replacing local-v1.
